script.text: In the Friendship Cup finals, Yuya faced off against the last tournament's winner: Jack Atlas!
Meanwhile, Roget used the ongoing chaos to take over the government.
Attention, people of New Domino! The chaos you are witnessing is proof that the High Council has failed you!
To ensure order, I have no choice but to assume full authority over this city and its government.
He's lying! He's using the chaos so he can take over the City! But people – both Commons and Topsiders – you can't let him! The City belongs to you!
Yuya! You have to convince them to stop fighting each other! Dueltain your way into their hearts!
Yuya and Jack took center stage.
Your attention, please! Jack Atlas and I are about to duke it out in the final bout of the Friendship Cup!
Jack and I will put on a show guaranteed to rock every block in this metropolis! It's showtime, Jack!
Oh, so you really think you can entertain MY crowd? We'll see about that!
